run_co3d_dataset_stats: run the script to print CO3D dataset sequence counts per category and split
count_category_sequences: count the number of sequences per set for a given CO3D dataset category
load_frame_annotations: load compressed frame annotation data from a CO3D category using load_dataclass_jgzip
group_frames_by_sequence: group frame annotations by sequence name using a defaultdict for a CO3D category
tabulate_category_counts: print a tabulated table of CO3D dataset sequence counts across all categories and sets
